source.author: verg
source.text: Quid non mortalia pectora cogis, auri sacra fames?
source.text_original: Quid non mortalia pectora cogis, / auri sacra fames?
source.text_english: What do you not drive mortal hearts to do, accursed hunger for gold?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Verum quid pectora humana non cogit Auri sacra fames?
reuse.text_original: Verum quid pectora humana non cogit  Auri sacra fames?
reuse.text_english: But what does the accursed hunger for gold not drive human hearts to?
